🔄 Content Update (Published: November 10, 2026 / Previous: November 12, 2026)
Key changes: Calligraphy workshop now includes eraser stamp making; detailed time schedule added. Christmas Concert performers unified as "S Quartet Music Box".

The Citizen Activities Center will hold winter events.

【Minkatsu Winter 2026】
Date and time: Sunday, December 6, 10:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
Venue: Citizen Activities Center

Citizen activity groups will present music, dance, kamishibai (picture shows), and other performances, plus workshops and a sales corner.

• From 11:00 a.m.: Performances by Machinaka Keyboard Circle, Jump the Kenji, Machinaka Singing for Health Class, Team of Dragon, Miki's Cheer, and Hakkioi Saxophone
• Exchange Plaza will have sales by Hanno City International Exchange Association, Okashi Kobo Aora, Saturday Hanno Latin Club, and KAFIN HANNO IRUMA. Citizen Activities Center will run two workshops: "Write Your Personal Kanji" (eraser stamp making) and "Decorate the Christmas Tree"
• Workshops first-come, first-served on the day (3 people per session, 4 sessions total); no advance reservation needed

【LINE App Practical Class】
Date and time: Sunday, December 6, 1:30 p.m.–3:30 p.m.
Venue: Citizen Activities Center Conference Room
Capacity: 15 people (by application order)
How to apply: Starting Sunday, November 8, call the Citizen Activities Center to register.
※ Please bring your own smartphone

【Christmas Concert】
Date and time: Saturday, December 19, 2:00 p.m.–3:00 p.m.
Venue: Multipurpose Hall
Performers: S Quartet Music Box
Capacity: 80 people (by application order)
How to apply: Starting Saturday, November 14, call the Citizen Activities Center to register.
Please use the City Hall parking lot when you visit.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jitishinkoka/shiminkatudou/10287.html
